frozen_against.note: Planning freeze only. No runtime reader consumes this catalog yet; every planned or reserved entry refuses honestly until its capability ships with test evidence.

capability_composition.pure_journal_or_exposure: A list containing only exposure capabilities and/or conversion-journal and/or conversion-observe does not implicitly require the attempt hook.
capability_composition.mixed_with_ordinary: Any selection containing a legacy ordinary capability keeps the existing attempt dependency.
capability_composition.duplicates: Duplicates are ignored; the first occurrence wins.
capability_composition.device_filter: Device filtering cannot hide global conversion or policy evidence; invalid combinations refuse with reason.

conversion-journal.reason: Parses; refuses as having no record channel.

conversion-observe.reason: Parses; refuses as having no record channel.

planned-exposure.reason: Rejected as unknown capability until the adapter ships.

platforms.note: Hardened ordinary preview only; ordinary evidence never qualifies confidential-guest claims.
No admitted cell selected; needs exact image/config/BTF identity plus safe-attachment proof before any live claim.
Distinct TDX semantics; one SNP run cannot qualify TDX. No admitted cell selected.
Includes the relevant paravisor topology; host-facing and paravisor peers stay distinct. No admitted cell selected.

source_reasons.meaning: No adapter exists yet; the capability is planned or reserved and refuses when requested.
Reviewed kernel sources expose no safe observation point for this entry.
Proof needs a real-cell lease that is not assigned; planning grants no lease.
Attachment or readout was refused by the platform (lockdown, permissions, hardening).
The expected hook or tracepoint does not exist on this kernel.
No exact platform cell is admitted for this entry yet.
Evidence exists but is held out of findings pending safety review.
A catalog reason explains why this platform cannot produce the entry; absence of events alone never qualifies.

kinds.rule: Freezes from admitted sources during adapter implementation; unknown kinds refuse. Never invented by adapters.

object_states.rule: Freezes from admitted sources during adapter implementation; the identity producer owns the values.

scopes.rule: Freezes from admitted sources during adapter implementation; scan and comparison scopes stay distinct.

null_reasons.rule: Freezes with the 0.3.0 schemas; reason codes are a closed slug set.

directions.rule: Freezes from admitted sources during adapter implementation; CPU-copy direction stays a separate dimension.

caller_classes.rule: Freezes from admitted sources during adapter implementation; sanitized classes only, never raw addresses.

counters.rule: Freezes from admitted sources during adapter implementation; each counter names its scope and epoch.

vocabularies.revision_rule: Frozen lists change only by catalog revision with a version bump; adapters select from frozen lists or wait for the deferred freeze.

field_conventions.u64: Canonical decimal strings, no signs, leading zeros, fractions or scientific notation; range checked to 18446744073709551615.
field_conventions.s64: JSON integers. Signed native results are outside the u64 decimal-string class.
field_conventions.optional: A field marked optional may have its key absent. Absent and null are different: absent means not applicable to this record.
field_conventions.null_with_reason: A field marked nullable may be null only with a sibling {name}_reason string carrying a typed reason code (vocabulary freezes with the 0.3.0 schemas). Unknown is never zero or an empty string.
field_conventions.labels: Closed enum values use underscores; identifier slugs (capabilities, sources, reasons, scenarios, subject and peer classes) use hyphens. Adapters cannot append arbitrary kernel labels.

scenarios.positive_setup: Covered conversion requests complete on an admitted confidential cell with caller context recorded.
scenarios.oracle: Independent owned-operation ledger plus native result agreement; wrapper success alone never establishes state.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-memory-management
scenarios.source_assumptions: Admitted journal channel, exact cell identity, safe attachment proof.

scenarios.positive_setup: Boot and pre-attach sharing is inventoried with exact owned increase/decrease deltas.
scenarios.oracle: Owned direct-map fixture with exact counts; interval, alias and race bounds checked.
scenarios.subject: guest-direct-map
scenarios.source_assumptions: Bounded scan completes inside one second on the admitted reference cell.

scenarios.positive_setup: An owned buffer moves shared-to-private across an admitted lifecycle boundary.
scenarios.oracle: Independent identity, generation and lifecycle ledger; failure, alias, reuse and loss never invent state.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-allocator
scenarios.source_assumptions: Source-admitted resolver with declared address space and generation model.

scenarios.positive_setup: A real persistent queue or control buffer carries steady traffic with no new conversions.
scenarios.oracle: Independent create, use and teardown ledger; coherent memory is not synonymous with host-shared.
scenarios.subject: guest-driver-virtio
scenarios.source_assumptions: Queue identity survives the capture window; steady traffic is independently driven.

scenarios.positive_setup: A shared-origin allocation is retained across multiple references and then released.
scenarios.oracle: Owned allocation ledger with attach, map, use and destruction kept distinct.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-allocator
scenarios.source_assumptions: Shared origin is admitted; generic buffer objects never imply confidential sharing.

scenarios.positive_setup: Covered SNP GHCB and #VC interface activity is observed on the matching SNP cell.
scenarios.oracle: Coverage and rejection-source catalog; supported native errors are facts and rate changes never prove an attack.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-cc-platform
scenarios.source_assumptions: SNP interface source admitted for the exact cell; unavailable subchannels labeled separately.

scenarios.positive_setup: Covered TDX #VE interface activity is observed on the matching TDX cell with per-exit metadata.
scenarios.oracle: TDX exit catalog with supported native errors as facts; rate changes never prove an attack.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-cc-platform
scenarios.source_assumptions: TDX #VE source admitted for the exact cell; SNP evidence never qualifies TDX.

scenarios.positive_setup: Channel offer, memory descriptor and flags agree across the channel lifetime.
scenarios.oracle: Host-facing versus confidential-paravisor negative controls; no inference into paravisor internal memory.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-vmbus
scenarios.source_assumptions: Peer topology is known; channel lifetime events are complete or explicitly gapped.

scenarios.positive_setup: A supported mapping class is observed on a real cell with presence, absence and unsupported fixtures.
scenarios.oracle: Independent mapping fixtures; inventory only, never a claim to trace every access.
scenarios.subject: guest-kernel-memory-management
scenarios.source_assumptions: Mapping class supported by the selected stack; disallowed uses stay unsupported.

scenarios.positive_setup: Swap backing, dump, driver and configuration facts are read from an independently configured guest.
scenarios.oracle: Configuration fixtures set independently of the collector; no payload and no exfiltration verdict.
scenarios.subject: guest-configuration
scenarios.source_assumptions: Configuration sources are allowlisted; facts are point-in-time unless a change source exists.

scenarios.positive_setup: Bounced and admitted non-bounced shared-path cases complete with outer completion agreement.
scenarios.oracle: Segment-level agreement ledger; missing bounce events never imply direct private DMA.
scenarios.subject: guest-driver-dma
scenarios.source_assumptions: Path admission per operation; outer completion observed independently.

scenarios.positive_setup: An unexpected covered operation trips an authored rule; a proved lifecycle violation, an independently established configuration deviation, and an inconclusive-on-unknown case are also shown.
scenarios.oracle: Golden policy files with expected findings, including configuration fixtures set independently of the collector; unknown required evidence prevents conformity.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Policy file immutable for the run; all applicable rules intersect.

scenarios.positive_setup: Two compatible captures produce per-metric deltas; an incompatible pair refuses per metric.
scenarios.oracle: Identity, profile, workload, window and unit compatibility checks; smaller totals never imply improved confidentiality.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Both captures carry the facts the requested metrics need.

scenarios.positive_setup: Loss, censored stop, denied access, absent sources and exhausted bounds each yield a scoped partial result.
scenarios.oracle: Injected-loss fixtures with exact expected gaps; no silent fallback and no loss converted to zero.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Every bounded operation carries a deadline; exhaustion is explicit.

scenarios.positive_setup: Healthy, seeded-unexpected, boot and pre-attach, incomplete, and metadata-indistinguishable cases each render with a next action; an exact candidate artifact qualifies across the supported cells.
scenarios.oracle: Held-out healthy workloads with zero false violations; seeded findings explainable end to end; exact-candidate bytes evidenced per cell.
scenarios.subject: capture-evidence
scenarios.source_assumptions: Examples ship with accurate provenance; provisional data is labeled as such.
